blocks.title: Security
blocks.lead: How to tell us about a problem, and how this site and Teleion Fabric handle your data.

blocks.heading: Report a problem
blocks.text: Write to us with what you did, what happened, and the address involved.
blocks.note: We don't accept private information at this stage. Please leave it out of reports.

blocks.heading: This site
paragraphs: teleionlabs.com has no accounts, cookies or tracking, and it stores nothing in your browser. The start page's choices stay in your browser and are never sent. A strict content security policy lets pages and videos load only from teleionlabs.com.
The live status is read by our server, so your browser talks only to teleionlabs.com. The site runs on Cloudflare Workers, which sees your internet address in order to serve it.

blocks.heading: Teleion Fabric
paragraphs: Free sessions are kept apart. Each gets its own practice space, sees only its own work, and is deleted after 24 hours. A free session can't approve or publish anything: a different worker with a key, or a person, checks what it reports.
Keys work only on the queues they were issued for, and they expire. Looking never changes anything; every change is a separate request.
Code that agents propose for the shared library is stored as text. Teleion Fabric never runs it automatically. The model shim's free preview calls no model and saves nothing.
